body:
# Music Player Mod (HUD)

A sleek, modern music player overlay for Minecraft that displays your currently playing media from Spotify, YouTube Music, and other Windows media sources directly in-game.

## ✨ Features

- **Real-time Media Display** - Shows current song title, artist, album art, and playback progress
- **Beautiful UI** - Glassmorphism design with smooth animations, blur effects, and rounded corners
- **Customizable Position** - Drag the HUD anywhere on screen while chat is open
- **Size Modes** - Toggle between small and big display sizes
- **Non-intrusive** - Transparent overlay that doesn't pause your game
- **Windows Media Integration** - Works with any media player that uses Windows Media API (Spotify, YouTube Music, Apple Music, etc.)
- **Smart Animations** - Smooth progress bar transitions and playback state indicators

## 🎮 How to Use

1. Press **M** (default keybind) to open the settings menu
2. Click **"Enable Player"** to activate the HUD
3. Open **chat** and **click and drag** the HUD to reposition it
4. Toggle between **small/big sizes** in the settings menu
5. The HUD automatically updates with your currently playing media

## 🎨 Design Features

- **Frosted glass background** with dynamic blur
- **Smooth progress bar** with animated thumb indicator
- **"Now Playing" badge** with pulse animation
- **Dynamic accent colors** - Green when playing, gray when paused
- **Ambient glow effect** around the panel
- **Album art display** with automatic cropping and fallback icon

## 📋 Requirements

- **Fabric Loader**
- **Minecraft 1.21**
- **Windows OS** (for media integration)
- **Fabric API** (if required by dependencies)

## 🔧 Configuration

- **Position**: Drag while chat is open
- **Size**: Toggle in settings menu (M key)
- **Enable/Disable**: Settings menu or keybind

## 📝 Notes

- This mod **only displays** media information and does not control playback
- It reads from **Windows Media API** to show what's currently playing on your system
- The HUD is **draggable only when chat is open** to prevent accidental movement during gameplay
- Position and settings are **automatically saved** when changed

## 🐛 Known Limitations

- **Windows only** - Media integration requires Windows Media API
- **Display only** - Cannot control playback (play/pause/skip)
- Media information depends on what the media player reports to Windows

## 💡 Tips

- If the HUD doesn't show media, make sure your media player is running and playing something
- The album art may take a moment to load when switching songs
- Long song titles will be automatically trimmed with "…"

---

Enjoy your music while playing Minecraft! 🎵
